sourceRefs.locator: pp. 20–21, figs. 1, 3–5. Seventh-century evidence and several superimposed dwellings, longhouses interpreted as byre-dwellings, clay loom weights from sunken buildings.
pp. 296–297, discussion of the genitium, screona and sunken buildings. Textile tools frequently occur in secondary fills. Single-purpose and gendered interpretations require further evidence.

summary.de: Gewichte für Kettfäden sind in Grubenhäusern belegt. Lage und Schicht eines Fundes entscheiden darüber, wie genau sich ein Arbeitsplatz bestimmen lässt.
summary.en: Weights for warp threads occur in sunken buildings. An object’s position and layer determine how closely we can locate a workplace.
